answer: A durable Sybil barrier is recurring, audited effort with slashing. A newcomer clears thirty audited jobs, escrows 180 units for two epochs, and wins four vouches from veteran peers whose ledgers never overlap. A clone reruns every job and posts fresh collateral, and a disproved job forfeits it. Since receipts cannot recur and vouchers cannot be shared, inherited standing is empty, so each extra puppet costs more than the influence it can ever buy. anchor dawn ivory
